descr: Lists medical specialties; optional name filter.
sqlt: SELECT name AS `Specialty`, description AS `Details` FROM specialties WHERE is_deleted = false AND name {{name}} coalesce(:name, name)

descr: List doctors with their patient appointment schedule
sqlt: SELECT CONCAT(d.first_name, ' ', d.last_name) AS `Doctor Name`, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS `Patient Name`, DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date, '%d %b %Y') AS `Appointment Date`, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%h:%i %p') AS `Start Time`, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%h:%i %p') AS `End Time`, CONCAT(a.duration_minutes, ' min') AS `Duration`, a.status AS `Status` FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.id = a.doctor_id JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE d.is_deleted = false AND a.is_deleted = false AND d.id {{doctorId}} COALESCE(:doctorId, d.id) AND a.appointment_date {{appointmentDate}} COALESCE(:appointmentDate, a.appointment_date) AND a.status {{status}} COALESCE(:status, a.status)

descr: Distribution of appointments by status
sqlt: SELECT a.status AS `Status`, COUNT(*) AS `Total` FROM appointments a WHERE a.is_deleted = false GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY a.status

descr: Total number of active doctors
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Total Doctors` FROM doctors WHERE is_deleted = false

descr: Total number of active patients
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Total Patients` FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = false

descr: Total appointments scheduled for today
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Today's Appointments` FROM appointments WHERE is_deleted = false AND appointment_date = CURDATE()

descr: Number of appointments grouped by medical specialty
sqlt: SELECT s.name AS `Specialty`, COUNT(a.id) AS `Appointments` FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.id = a.doctor_id JOIN doctor_specialties_map dsm ON dsm.doctor_id = d.id JOIN specialties s ON s.id = dsm.specialty_id WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false AND s.is_deleted = false GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY `Appointments` DESC

descr: Number of appointments for each doctor
sqlt: SELECT CONCAT(d.first_name, ' ', d.last_name) AS `Doctor`, COUNT(a.id) AS `Appointments` FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name ORDER BY `Appointments` DESC

descr: Daily appointment trend for the last 30 days
sqlt: SELECT a.appointment_date AS `Date`, COUNT(*) AS `Appointments` FROM appointments a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.appointment_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND a.appointment_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY a.appointment_date ORDER BY a.appointment_date

descr: Number of active doctors in each specialty
sqlt: SELECT s.name AS `Specialty`, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS `Doctors` FROM doctors d JOIN doctor_specialties_map dsm ON dsm.doctor_id = d.id JOIN specialties s ON s.id = dsm.specialty_id WHERE d.is_deleted = false AND s.is_deleted = false GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY `Doctors` DESC

descr: Total number of scheduled appointments
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Scheduled Appointments` FROM appointments WHERE is_deleted = false AND status = 'SCHEDULED'

descr: Total number of completed appointments
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Completed Appointments` FROM appointments WHERE is_deleted = false AND status = 'COMPLETED'

descr: Number of active patients by gender
sqlt: SELECT gender AS `Gender`, COUNT(*) AS `Patients` FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY gender ORDER BY `Patients` DESC

descr: Monthly appointment trend
sqlt: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date, '%Y-%m') AS `Month`, COUNT(*) AS `Appointments` FROM appointments a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.appointment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `Month`

nm: list all patients with their blood group
descr: list all patients with their blood group
sqlt: SELECT first_name AS `First Name`, last_name AS `Last Name`, blood_group AS `Blood Group` FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = false

descr: list all patient
sqlt: SELECT first_name AS `First Name`, last_name AS `Last Name`, email AS `Email` FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = false

nm: list top 5 doctor having maximum appointment
descr: list top 5 doctor having maximum appointment
sqlt:
SELECT d.first_name, d.last_name, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count
FROM doctors d
JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.id
WHERE d.is_deleted = false
  AND a.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name
ORDER BY appointment_count DESC
LIMIT 5

nm: how many doctors work on sunday
descr: how many doctors work on sunday
sqlt: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS `Doctors Working On Sunday` FROM doctor_availabilities av JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id WHERE av.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false AND av.day_of_week = 'SUNDAY'

descr: i want all doctor all day working time and doctor firstname and lastname as name
sqlt:
SELECT CONCAT(d.first_name, ' ', d.last_name) AS Name,
       av.day_of_week AS Day,
       (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, av.start_time, av.end_time) - COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, av.break_start_time, av.break_end_time), 0)) AS WorkingTime
FROM doctor_availabilities av
JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id
WHERE av.is_deleted = false
  AND d.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY d.first_name, d.last_name, av.day_of_week

descr: list  only cardiology doctor available on monday also can you join firstname and lastname as name also its timing
sqlt:
SELECT CONCAT(d.first_name, ' ', d.last_name) AS `Name`, av.start_time AS `Start Time`, av.end_time AS `End Time`
FROM doctors d
JOIN doctor_specialties_map m ON m.doctor_id = d.id
JOIN specialties s ON s.id = m.specialty_id
JOIN doctor_availabilities av ON av.doctor_id = d.id
WHERE d.is_deleted = false
  AND s.is_deleted = false
  AND av.is_deleted = false
  AND s.name = 'Cardiology'
  AND av.day_of_week = 'MONDAY'
